entries.name: TIP-WEDM-001
entries.description: Reduce on-time for thin sections: For sections < 5mm, reduce on-time by 20-30% to prevent wire breakage

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-002
entries.description: Increase flushing for deep cuts: For cuts > 50mm, increase flushing pressure 20% and add dwell at corners

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-003
entries.description: Use zinc wire for carbide: Zinc-coated wire improves cut quality on carbide by 15-20%

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-004
entries.path: tip:Pre-drill start holes for thick parts
entries.description: Pre-drill start holes for thick parts: Parts > 40mm: pre-drill 3mm start holes to reduce threading time

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-005
entries.description: Lower tension for taper cuts: Reduce wire tension 10-15% for taper angles > 10 degrees

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-006
entries.description: Check dielectric conductivity daily: Maintain conductivity 15-25 uS/cm for optimal cutting

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-007
entries.description: Slow down at sharp corners: Reduce feedrate 30% at corners < 0.5mm radius

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-008
entries.description: Multiple skim cuts for Ra < 0.4: 3+ skim passes required for mirror finish Ra < 0.4 um

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-009
entries.description: Warm up machine 30 min: Allow 30 min warm-up for tolerance < 5 um

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-010
entries.description: Check wire verticality weekly: Verify wire is vertical within 2 um/100mm weekly

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-011
entries.description: Use diffuser nozzles for slots: Diffuser nozzles improve flushing in narrow slots

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-012
entries.description: Increase off-time in rough cuts: Higher off-time in roughing prevents wire wear

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-013
entries.description: Monitor filter pressure: Replace filters when pressure exceeds 150 kPa

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-014
entries.description: D2 tool steel best practices: D2 cuts best with E1847-E1850 E-codes at 25-35mm

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-015
entries.description: Carbide requires slower parameters: Reduce MRR 40% for carbide vs tool steel

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-016
entries.description: Check wire path for obstacles: Verify wire path clear before starting unattended runs

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-017
entries.description: Log all wire breaks: Track break location, material, parameters for pattern analysis

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-018
entries.path: tip:Use adaptive control for varying thickness
entries.description: Use adaptive control for varying thickness: Enable adaptive for parts with 2:1+ thickness variation

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-019
entries.path: tip:Clamp work firmly for heavy slugs
entries.description: Clamp work firmly for heavy slugs: Large slugs can shift workpiece - verify clamping force

entries.name: TIP-WEDM-020
entries.description: Test new materials on coupons: Always run test coupon on unknown materials first
